verdict.rationale: The open-source Ramp CLI is built for headless use: `--agent` emits JSON for scripting (the default when piped), `--no-input` disables prompts for CI, standalone agents log in without a browser via OAuth client credentials (RAMP_CLIENT_ID/RAMP_CLIENT_SECRET), and RAMP_PROFILE pins an identity for automation. The CLI defaults to the sandbox for safe testing, and the Developer API supports a server-to-server Client Credentials flow backed by a live, probed OpenAPI schema. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of an actual CI run, documented CI pipeline recipes (e.g. GitHub Actions examples).
